voice: A young adult American male storyteller with a clear, warm, energetic voice, narrating a viral fun-fact video with punchy, conversational, slightly dramatic pacing.

lines.direction: Fast-paced, energetic, intriguing storytelling, like a viral short-video narrator.
lines.text: In eighteen sixty, an eleven-year-old girl wrote to Abraham Lincoln. Her advice? Grow a beard. He replied: wouldn't people call it silly? Then he grew one anyway.
